## Release checks

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests pass, or skipped tests are explained.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, internal URLs, real municipal data, logs, or captures are included.
- [ ] Every dataset is independently synthetic with documented rules and seeds.
- [ ] Every model artifact has reproducible synthetic-only provenance.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied material have reviewed licences.
- [ ] Generated files and manifests are updated where required.

All contributions are reviewed before acceptance; submission does not guarantee merging.
